name: supacrawl
description: Sitemap-based website monitoring tool with DDoS-safe crawling

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @supacrawl/core build && concurrently --raw -n worker,dashboard -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @supacrawl/worker dev" "pnpm --filter @supacrawl/dashboard dev"
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist, node_modules, .turbo -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; pnpm install
